title: 2 days only — lifetime access to ChatGPT, Claude, and more in one AI dashboard for a one-time $57.97
excerpt: See what multiple models have to say.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get ChatPlayground AI Unlimited Lifetime for $57.97 through tomorrow, July 26, and compare ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more side by side with unlimited messages.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$57.97
$619 Save $561.03

AI is incredibly useful, but relying on just one model can sometimes leave you wondering if there’s a better answer. That’s exactly the issue ChatPlayground AI is designed to solve.

Through tomorrow, July 26, you can get the ChatPlayground AI Unlimited Lifetime Subscription for a one-time $57.97 payment, giving you one place to compare responses from 20+ leading AI models instead of bouncing between multiple websites.

Rather than copying and pasting the same prompt into different chatbots (and paying for each of them), ChatPlayground lets you ask once and instantly compare answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Perplexity, and other leading AI models.

Seeing multiple perspectives side by side makes it easier to refine ideas, verify information, brainstorm, or simply choose the response that best fits your needs.

The platform also includes much more than AI chat. You can upload PDFs and images to ask questions about your files, generate AI images, save your chat history for future reference, and use built-in prompt engineering tools to improve the quality of your results over time.

With the Unlimited Plan, you’ll get unlimited messages each month, making it a practical option for anyone who uses AI throughout the workday. Writers, marketers, developers, students, entrepreneurs, and researchers can all benefit from having multiple AI models available through a single streamlined dashboard.

If you’re already using AI regularly, comparing answers rather than relying on a single response is a simple way to work with greater confidence and resources.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get the ChatPlayground AI Unlimited lifetime subscription for $57.97 through tomorrow, July 26.

$57.97
$619 Save $561.03

人工智能非常有用，但仅依赖一种模型有时会让您想知道是否有更好的答案。 这正是 ChatPlayground AI 旨在解决的问题。

截至明天，即 7 月 26 日，您只需一次性支付 57.97 美元即可获得 ChatPlayground AI 无限终身订阅，让您可以比较 20 多个领先 AI 模型的响应，而无需在多个网站之间跳来跳去。

ChatPlayground 无需将相同的提示复制并粘贴到不同的聊天机器人中（并为每个聊天机器人付费），而是让您询问一次并立即比较来自 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Llama、Perplexity 和其他领先 AI 模型的答案。

并排查看多个视角可以更轻松地完善想法、验证信息、集思广益，或者只是选择最适合您需求的响应。

该平台还不仅仅包括人工智能聊天。 您可以上传 PDF 和图像来询问有关文件的问题、生成 AI 图像、保存聊天记录以供将来参考，并使用内置的提示工程工具来随着时间的推移提高结果的质量。

通过无限制计划，您每月将收到无限的消息，这对于整个工作日使用人工智能的任何人来说都是一个实用的选择。 作家、营销人员、开发人员、学生、企业家和研究人员都可以通过一个简化的仪表板获得多个人工智能模型，从而受益。

如果您已经定期使用人工智能，那么比较答案而不是依赖单一响应是一种简单的方法，可以让您更有信心和资源地工作。

混搭优惠
